channel.title: Strictly Come Dancing
channel.desc: It's fright night in the ballroom as the couples face the results of the Halloween spectacular. The pros get their fangs out for a group routine dedicated to Dracula, and there's music from Becky Hill. As another dance-off unfolds, who will make it to the halfway point of the competition? And whose Halloween weekend will turn into a nightmare?
